source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_dispatcher.py tests/test_codex_adapter.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py tests/test_operator.py -q

claims.claim: Dispatcher retains exactly-one selected-Executor authority and now exposes only provider-neutral mutation and bounded-execution policy.
Codex command construction, sandbox mapping, timeout handling, UTF-8 decoding, structural output normalization, and native failures are owned by CodexAdapter.
Antigravity handoffs, AGY commands, mode and permission mapping, instructions, deadlines, envelope parsing, BOM-compatible normalization, and failures are owned by AntigravityAdapter.
PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR preserve single-invocation behavior, native-role boundaries, terminal timeout and failure behavior, and Runtime-owned completion and evidence authority.
Operator behavior is unchanged apart from resolving and passing the provider-neutral execution policy.

Regression coverage now checks the neutral Dispatcher surface, provider-owned mechanics, read-only and mutation mappings, deadlines, terminal failures, and operation continuity using injected native runners.
